notes: Stories created for Evaluate Care Facade Orchestration with full coverage: schema, logic, API, integration, tests.

stories.title: Define Evaluate Care Facade Request/Response Schema
stories.description: Define a unified contract for Evaluate Care facade covering clinical trials search and provider detail lookup, including input normalization and consistent response envelope for cross-domain extensibility.

stories.title: Implement Facade Orchestration Logic
stories.description: Implement core orchestration logic that routes requests to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, aggregates results, and enforces consistent formatting and error handling.

stories.title: Expose Evaluate Care Facade via Tool Router Interface
stories.description: Integrate Evaluate Care facade with tool_router to expose unified endpoints for agent tool use, ensuring compatibility with existing tool invocation patterns and validation.

stories.title: Integration with Domain Services
stories.description: Ensure seamless integration between facade and domain services including clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, validating data flow, transformation, and fallback handling.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Facade Orchestration
stories.description: Create tests validating schema compliance, orchestration routing, error handling, and end-to-end flows through the facade using both clinical trials and provider detail scenarios.
